name: Seashell Telescope
description: An intricate telescope assembled from polished and carved seashells, mounted on a weathered wooden stand atop a windswept coastal cliff, with dramatic clouds and ocean views.
prompt: A magnificent telescope built entirely from intricately carved and polished seashells—conch, nautilus, scallop, and cowrie shells forming the tubes and mount. Weathered wooden stand on a windswept coastal cliff. Dramatic storm clouds gathering over a turquoise ocean. Golden hour lighting, high detail, maritime atmosphere, 8k
caption: Stargazing has never looked this seashell-fabulous! 🐚🔭 Perched on the edge of the world, this telescope carved from ocean treasures promises adventures beyond the horizon. If you could spy on any mystery of the deep, what would you look for first? The ocean holds its secrets well...
